verdict.rationale: Formant's materials claim single-pane fleet visibility. They describe "instant visibility into every robot in your fleet", "one view across every vendor's fleet" and a "single operator view" for multiple fleets. They also say current location and status are tracked alongside per-robot history. Analytics dashboards can aggregate by device group or tag, and anomaly alerts cover health monitoring. Most of this comes from marketing pages rather than detailed product docs. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of a fleet-wide health and location map view, explicit health metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
